head.index.title: Lecturameter · Isilandeli sokufunda nezibalo zezincwadi
head.index.description: Landelela isikhathi sakho sokufunda, amakhasi, isivinini nenqubekelaphambili ngesilandeli sokufunda se-Android esiyimfihlo. Akukho akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso. Ngenisa ku-Goodreads nase-StoryGraph.
head.index.ld_description: Hlela ilabhulali yakho, linganisa isikhathi seziqeshana zokufunda ubone izibalo eziningiliziwe efonini yakho ye-Android. Azikho izikhangiso, ubumfihlo obuphelele.
head.index.ld_featurelist: Ilabhulali enamashalufu, isitophuwashi sisebenza isikrini sicimile, umlando weziqeshana, imephu yokushisa, i-Wrapped yonyaka, izinselelo zokufunda ezishintshekayo, ikhophi yesipele ye-Google Drive, ukungenisa i-CSV ye-Goodreads, kuyasebenza kakhulu ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi
head.index.faq1_q: Ngingayilethela ilabhulali yami evela kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza?
head.index.faq1_a: Yebo. Iya ku-Izilungiselelo > Ngenisa/Thumela ngaphandle bese ulandela umlingisi wesinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezixhasiwe: Goodreads (CSV): thumela ngaphandle kusuka ku-goodreads.com > My Books > Import and export > Export Library. StoryGraph (CSV): thumela ngaphandle kusuka ku-app.thestorygraph.com > Manage account > Import/Export > Export STG Library (i-CSV ifika nge-imeyili). Bookmory (.bookmory noma XLSX): Izilungiselelo > Ikhophi yesipele > Thumela ngaphandle. Fable / ShelfBridge (CSV): thumela ngaphandle ngesandiso se-ShelfBridge. Book Tracker (CSV): Izilungiselelo > Thumela ngaphandle. I-Lecturameter CSV: ethunyelwe ngaphandle kusuka kwenye idivayisi esebenzisa i-Lecturameter. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza (Babelio, Pagebound, Bookshelf, Delibrista…): noma iyiphi i-CSV ehambisana nefomethi ye-Goodreads/StoryGraph.
head.index.faq2_a: Impela. Idatha yakho igcinwa efonini yakho kuphela. Ilabhulali yakho ayisoze yashiya idivayisi yakho. Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela izibalo zokusetshenziswa ezingaziwa negama kanye nezinkombandlela zokuphahlazeka, ongakwazi ukuzivala ku-Izilungiselelo. Futhi, uma usesho lungatholi lutho, leso sicashazi noma i-ISBN igcinwa, ngaphandle kwesihlonzi, ukuze imisebenzi engekho yengezwe. Uma unika amandla ikhophi yesipele ye-Google Drive, nguwe kuphela onokufinyelela kulawo mafayela.
head.index.faq3_a: Cha. Uhlelo lokusebenza lumahhala nokuthenga kanye kwe-Pro okungakhethwa.
head.index.faq4_a: Cishe konke kusebenza ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi. Udinga ukuxhumeka kuphela ukuze useshe izincwadi ezintsha nokulayisha amakhophi esipele ku-Google Drive.
head.index.faq5_a: Yebo, isiku-beta evulelekile: ungayizama manje nge-TestFlight. Uma ingafaki okwamanje, buya emuva ngemuva kwesikhashana.
head.index.faq6_a: Yebo. Kukhona ukuzama mahhala kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kwezici ze-Pro, akudingeki ikhadi. Ku-iPhone kuyikuthenga mahhala ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza ku-App Store, okuboshelwe ku-Apple ID yakho. Ku-Android, ekupheleni kokuzama, ngisho noma ungayithengi i-Pro, uthola ithemu le-Pro mahhala olikhethayo.
head.index.faq7_q: Kwenzekani nge-Pro yami uma ngishintsha ifoni?
head.index.faq7_a: Kuncike lapho uyithengele khona. Uma uyithengele ku-Google Play bese uguqukela kwenye i-Android ngeakhawunti ye-Google efanayo, faka i-Lecturameter bese uthinta Buyisela ukuthenga ku-Izilungiselelo. Uma uyithengele ku-App Store bese uguqukela kwenye i-iPhone nge-Apple ID efanayo, kuyafana: faka bese uthinta Buyisela ukuthenga. Ukuthutha phakathi kwe-Android ne-iPhone nganoma iyiphi indlela, sebenzisa ikhodi yokudlulisa: efonini yakho yamanje, ku-Izilungiselelo ze-Lecturameter, Bhangqa idivayisi, thola ikhodi yesikhashana, yifake kudivayisi entsha bese isebenza lapho nayo. Amakhodi e-lm-... angasetshenziswa ku-Android kuphela. Uma uthengisa noma ulahlekelwa idivayisi endala, ungayiphikisa kusukela esikrinini esifanayo.
head.index.faq8_q: Ngingayithutha i-Pro yami phakathi kwamafoni naphakathi kwe-iOS ne-Android?
head.index.faq8_a: Yebo, phakathi kwe-Android ne-iPhone, nganoma iyiphi indlela. Wenza lokho ngekhodi yokudlulisa eyenziwa ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza, ku-Izilungiselelo. Phakathi kwamafoni amabili ohlelo olufanayo awudingi: sebenzisa ukubuyisela ukuthenga ngeakhawunti yakho ye-Google noma i-Apple ID.

release.3_7.headline: I-beta ye-iPhone, amahlaya noma-manga njengezincwadi ezibalulekile, ukubuka Uchungechunge
release.3_7.new: Amahlaya, ama-manga namabhuku omsindo njengezinto ezibalulekile: wengeze ngefomu elilodwa lokuzenzela noma amaningi ngasikhathi sinye, bese wabelana ngekhadi lakho lebhuku lomsindo
Letha ilabhulali yakho evela kwenye iapp (Goodreads, StoryGraph, Bookmory, Fable) ngokubuka kusengaphambili
Ukubuka Uchungechunge: izincwadi zakho zihlanganiswe ngochungechunge, kugcwaliswe ngokuzenzakalelayo uma uzengeza
Isifinyezo senyanga nekhadi ongabelana ngalo, kanye ne-"Incwadi yakho yenyanga ngayinye" ku-Wrapped
Amakhadi ami: wonke amakhadi owabelane ngawo, endaweni eyodwa
Engeza izincwadi eziningana ngasikhathi sinye usuka ekuseshweni
Amakhredithi ngoshicilelo ngalunye: abalandisi, abahumushi nabadwebi
I-Pro isebenza kuze kufike kumadivayisi angu-3, i-Android ne-iOS
Amakhophi esipele manje agcina namathegi nezikhumbuzo zakho
Manje ungalondoloza iseshini yokufunda ngaphandle kwamakhasi, isikhathi kuphela (kuyasiza uma ufunda ngedijithali)
release.3_7.fixes: Ukususa izincwadi eziningana kunikeza Ukuhlehlisa okukodwa
Imibhalo manje ibiza uhlobo: incwadi, ikhomiki, i-manga noma incwadi ezwakalayo
Umugqa wezinkanyezi awusakusika isikolo ngenkathi ushayela
Izinsuku namaphutha ekhophi yesipele ngolimi lohlelo lokusebenza
Ukubuyisela kusuka ku-Drive akusakhethi ifayela elingalungile
Kuvinjelwe ukuphahlazeka uma uthinta isixhumanisi sombhali kwezinye izimo
Imilayezo icace kakhulu ku-Ngenisa nase-Thumela ngaphandle
Kuvinjelwe ukuvaleka okungalindelekile lapho kuthengwa i-Pro nakwamanye ama-widget

release.3_8.headline: Inqubekelaphambili ngo-%, izingubo nezikhumba ze-Pagi, KOSync, izilimi ezibhalwa kusuka kwesokudla ziye kwesokunxele
release.3_8.new: Inqubekelaphambili ngo-%: rekhoda iziqeshana zakho njengephesenti ezincwadini, kuma-comics, kuma-manga nakuma-audiobook. Kuma-audiobook ungaphinda ubhale nesikhathi.
Shintsha ifomethi yencwadi, i-comic, i-manga noma i-audiobook ngemva kokuyengeza, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa iziqeshana, amanothi noma izibalo.
Amanothi nemibhalo eminingana uma uqeda isiqeshana, ngayinye ngokwayo.
Uma uphuma esiqeshaneni ungagcinanga, sigcinwa njengedrafti futhi ungasithola kabusha ngokuzayo lapho ugcina.
Izibalo: idonathi eveza lokho okufundayo ngefomethi nesihlungi sefomethi ukubona uhlobo ngalunye ngokwalo.
Izinselele ze-audiobook (amahora alalelwe nama-audiobook aqediwe) ne-Bingo enama-audiobook: ihora eli-1 lokulalela libalwa njengamakhasi angu-30.

I-Pagi iqala ngezingubo ezi-7 zesizini ezinopopayi ezisebenza nanoma iyiphi itimu, izikhumba ezintsha ezi-9 (Imbongi, Isela Lasebusuku, Ikhawundi Yegazi, Induna Yomkhumbi Ongaphansi Kwamanzi, Uyinki, I-Origami, Umfundi Wasebusuku, Isikhulu Esizulayo ne-Retro Astronaut) kanye nopopayi bayo bokuthinta ngayinye. Kukhona nesikhumba esiyimfihlo esifihlwe kuhlelo: thinta ezindaweni ezahlukene esikrinini esikhulu ukuze usithole.
I-Pagi inesigaba sayo Ezilungisweni: isizini ezenzakalelayo, izingubo zesizini ngaphandle kwesizini, nezikhumba.

Izithonjana zohlelo lokusebenza ze-Pro: khetha eyakho Ezilungisweni, kunezinguqulo ze-Halloween, zikaKhisimusi nezoNyaka Omusha. Uma uvula ukushintsha kwesizini okuzenzakalelayo, isithonjana siguquka ezinsukwini zaso bese sibuyela kweyakho. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Uma uzame i-Pro, uthola nesinye sezithonjana ze-Pro njengesipho.
Vumelanisa inqubekelaphambili yakho ne-e-reader nge-KOSync (i-KOReader nezihambisanayo), ngosizo lwesinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
Uhlelo manje lusesi-Arabhu, esiHebheru, esiPheresiya nesi-Urdu, olunesixhumi esibonakalayo esisuka kwesokudla siye kwesokunxele. Ungazikhetha futhi njengolimi lwencwadi uma wengeza incwadi ngesandla.
Imisindo emisha yesibali sikhathi se-Pro, enesigaba esisha, i-Cozy.
release.3_8.fixes: Ukukhethwa kohlobo okungcono kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezincwadi.
Eminye imibala yezibalo iguqulwe ukuze iphoyinti ngalinye ledatha libonakale kangcono.
Uma incwadi ye-e-reader ingenaso isihloko, kuboniswa igama elifundekayo esikhundleni sekhodi, futhi usizo luyakuxwayisa uma kungafiki nqubekelaphambili nomsebenzisi wakho.
Zonke izilimi ziyaphononongwa: imibhalo eyayivela ngesiNgisi noma ngesiSpanishi manje ivela ngolimi lwakho.
Izipele ezigcinwe efonini yakho azisaphelelwa yilutho uma ukugcina kuhluleka.
Ukushintsha isimo sencwadi akusasusi izinsuku zokufunda zangaphambilini.
Isifinyezo senyanga sibala nezincwadi eziqediwe ezingenaziqeshana.

legal.privacy.p_020: Izibalo zokusetshenziswa ezingaziwa negama (ezingakhethwa): uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela kuseva ye-Lecturameter uqobo (ebikwa ku-Cloudflare) isihlonzi sokufaka esingahleliwe esenziwe uhlelo lokusebenza ngokwalo, esishintsha njalo ezinsukwini ezingu-90 futhi asixhunyiwe kubuwena, ku-ID yesikhangiso sedivayisi noma kunoma iyiphi iakhawunti; inguqulo yohlelo lokusebenza, uhlelo lokusebenza namagama emicimbi yomkhiqizo (isibonelo: incwadi yokuqala yengeziwe, ukuzama kuqalile noma kuphelile, ikhadi lokwabelana lisetshenzisiwe), kanye nokuthi ubuya yini kuhlelo lokusebenza ngosuku lwe-1, lwe-7 nolwe-30. Akukho lutho oluvela elabhulali yakho, azikho izihloko zezincwadi futhi akukho idatha yomuntu othumelwayo. Le datha ayisetshenziswa ekukhangiseni, ekulandeleleni phakathi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, noma ekwenzeni iphrofayili, futhi ayithengiswa kubantu besithathu.
legal.privacy.p_021: Izinkombandlela zokuphahlazeka (ezingakhethwa): uma uhlelo lokusebenza luvaleka ngokungalindelekile noma, ku-Android, lushiya ukuphendula, luthumela umbiko wobuchwepheshe kuseva ye-Lecturameter: uhlobo nomlayezo wephutha, umkhondo wekhodi yohlelo lokusebenza (ekumiseni kwe-Android, ukhoko oluyinhloko kuphela), inguqulo yohlelo lokusebenza, imodeli nomkhiqizi wedivayisi, inguqulo yesistimu nolimi. Ayifaki ilabhulali yakho, amanothi akho noma noma yisiphi isihlonzi. Umlayezo wephutha wobuchwepheshe, kodwa kwezinye izikhathi ezingavamile ungafaka ucezu lwedatha eyidale. Ungakuvala ku-Izilungiselelo > Usizo nokuthi mayelana > Ubumfihlo > Izinkombandlela zokuphahlazeka.
legal.privacy.p_022: Zombili izinketho zingavalwa ku-Izilungiselelo > Usizo nokuthi mayelana > Ubumfihlo (izishintshi “Izibalo zokusetshenziswa” kanye “Izinkombandlela zokuphahlazeka”).
legal.privacy.p_024: Uma useshela incwadi noma uskena i-ISBN, lowo mbhalo noma ikhodi iya kuseva yekhathalogu ye-Lecturameter (ebikwa ku-Cloudflare), ebuza amakhathalogu ezincwadi omphakathi ngawe (Google Books, Open Library, Wikidata, AniList, MangaUpdates, Kitsu) ukuletha isihloko, ikhava noma umbhali. Iseva yethu ayigcini ikheli lakho le-IP, futhi imiphumela igcinwa ekhasheni lesikhashana (kusuka emahoreni ambalwa kuya ezinsukwini ezingu-30) elingaxhunyiwe kunoma ubani. Akukho datha yakho yomuntu othunyelwa kulezi zicelo.
legal.privacy.p_025: I-Lecturameter ifaka futhi ikhathalogu yezincwadi yasendaweni kudivayisi yakho: isizindalwazi sayo esinemisebenzi eyizi-12,000 elandwa kanye nohlelo lokusebenza. Yiyo evumela ukuseshela izincwadi ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi. Leyo khathalogu iyinto yohlelo lokusebenza, ayinayo idatha yakho, futhi akukho ongasesha kuyo noma okutholayo okusoze kwashiya idivayisi yakho.
legal.privacy.p_026: Uma ikhathalogu ye-Lecturameter ingatholi lutho ngosesho lwakho, noma wengeza incwadi eyayingekho kuyo, iseva yethu igcina lokho okuseshile (umbhalo, kuze kufike ezinhlamvwini ezingu-200, noma i-ISBN), uhlobo losesho, izihlonzi zencwadi oyengezayo, usuku nokuhashwa kwe-user agent yohlelo lokusebenza, ukuze sazi ukuthi yiyiphi imisebenzi engekho futhi sikwazi ukuyengeza. Ayigcini ikheli lakho le-IP noma isihlonzi sakho noma sedivayisi yakho, futhi igcina lokhu izinsuku ezingu-90 ubuningi. Lokhu kusiza bonke abasebenzisi ukuthuthukisa ikhathalogu, ngakho ayinaso isishintshi ku-Izilungiselelo. Ungafunda ukuthi leyo khathalogu iyaphi kuphi ku-lesi sigaba setshalo.
legal.privacy.p_028: Ukuthumela impendulo noma ukuphendula inhlolovo ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza kuyikho konke okuzikhethelayo. Uma ukhetha ukwenza kanjalo, umbhalo owubhalile uthunyelwa kanye nolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe ledivayisi (imodeli, inguqulo ye-OS (Android noma iOS), nenguqulo yohlelo lokusebenza) kumthuthukisi we-Lecturameter, ukuze akwazi ukuyifunda nokuthuthukisa uhlelo lokusebenza. Uma ukhetha futhi ukunamathisela amalogi ohlelo lokusebenza noma izithombe zesikrini, nalokho kuyathunyelwa; kokubili kuyakhethwa futhi kufakwa kuphela uma ukwengeza.
legal.privacy.p_030: Inkokhelo ye-Lecturameter Pro iphethwe yi-Google Play (ku-Android) noma i-Apple App Store (ku-iOS): uhlelo lokusebenza alukaze lubone noma lugcine imininingwane yakho yokukhokha. Ku-iOS kukhona futhi amathiphu akhethwayo (ukuthenga ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza okusetshenziswayo) angavuli lutho. Uma uthenga noma ubuyisela ukuthenga, isihlonzi sokuthenga sesitolo sithunyelwa kuseva yelayisense ye-Lecturameter ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthenga kuphela. Uma uthola ikhodi yokukhushulwa, leyo khodi nesihlonzi sedivayisi kuthunyelwa kuseva yokuthola ye-Lecturameter, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhodi nokukhawulela ukuthi mangaki amadivayisi angayisebenzisa.
legal.privacy.p_032: Ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kabi kokuzama mahhala nokuqinisekisa ilayisense yakho ye-Pro, uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela isihlonzi sedivayisi kuseva yelayisense ye-Lecturameter (ebikwa ku-Cloudflare): i-Android ID ku-Android, isihlonzi somthengisi ku-iOS. Asisetshenziswa ekukhangiseni noma ekwenzeni iphrofayili futhi asixhunyiwe egameni lakho.
legal.privacy.p_034: Kuyakhethwa: uma ungaxhumi isifundi se-e, akukho lutho olusithunyelwa. Uma uxhuma esisodwa (KOReader, CrossPoint noma esinye esihambisana ne-KOSync), uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela kuseva yokuvumelanisa ye-Lecturameter (ebikwa ku-Cloudflare, eNtshonalanga Yurophu) igama lomsebenzisi lokuvumelanisa (izinhlamvu ezingu-3 kuya kwezingu-32, ngaphandle kwe-imeyili noma idatha yomuntu; akuyona iakhawunti ye-Lecturameter) nokhiye osetshenziswa isifundi sakho se-e, iseva ewugcina njengehashi enosawoti kuphela. Ngencwadi ngayinye evumelanisiwe igcina isihlonzi sedokhumenti, indawo, iphesenti, igama nesihlonzi sedivayisi, usuku futhi, uma isifundi sakho se-e sizithumela, isihloko, ababhali negama lefayela. Asigcini ikheli lakho le-IP: imikhawulo yezicelo ibalwa ngokushesha yi-Cloudflare.
legal.privacy.p_035: Ungayisusa kanjani: uma unqamula isifundi se-e, khetha "Futhi susa idatha yami kuseva". Umsebenzisi nayo yonke inqubekelaphambili yakhe kuyasuswa kuseva. Uma ungasenawo uhlelo lokusebenza noma isifundi se-e, bhalela lecturameter.app@gmail.com ngegama lakho lomsebenzisi lokuvumelanisa bese sisusa umsebenzisi nayo yonke inqubekelaphambili yakhe kuseva ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ubuningi.
legal.privacy.li_038: I-inthanethi: ukuseshela izincwadi, ukwenza ikhophi yesipele ku-Drive, ukuthumela impendulo, ukuthola amakhodi, ukuqala ukuzama mahhala, nokuthumela izibalo ezingaziwa negama nezinkombandlela zokuphahlazeka (uma kuvuliwe).
legal.privacy.li_039: Isitoreji sasendaweni nezithombe: ukulondoloza nokufunda amakhophi akho esipele namakhava ezincwadi kudivayisi.

legal.terms.p_031: Ukuphathwa kwedatha kuchazwe ku-Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo, eyingxenye yale Migomo.
legal.terms.p_033: Uyavuma ukungenzi i-reverse engineering ye-Uhlelo lokusebenza, ukungagwemi izindlela zokuqinisekisa ze-Pro, noma ukungasebenzisi Uhlelo lokusebenza ngezinhloso eziphambene nomthetho.
legal.terms.p_035: Uhlelo lokusebenza lunikezwa "njengoba lunjalo". Ngezinga elivunyelwe umthetho, isibopho esiphezulu somthuthukisi asisoze saphuma esamba owasikhokha ezinyangeni eziyi-12 ngaphambi kwesimangalo. Lokhu kukhawulelwa akusebenzi ekulimaleni okubangelwa ukwenza kabi ngamabomu noma ukunganaki okukhulu komthuthukisi, nakumalungelo abathengi angakwazi ukuyekwa ngaphansi komthetho we-EU.
legal.terms.p_036: Umthuthukisi akenzi isibopho ngokulahlekelwa idatha okubangelwa ukwehluleka kwedivayisi noma ukukhipha Uhlelo lokusebenza. Sebenzisa izici zokuthumela ngaphandle ukugcina amakhophi esipele.
legal.terms.p_038: Umthuthukisi angase abuyekeze le Migomo. Izinguquko ezibalulekile zizoxoxwa okungenani izinsuku ezingu-30 kusengaphambili ngesaziso Ohlelweni lokusebenza noma kule webhusayithi. Ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisa kuyakwamukela.
legal.terms.p_040: Le Migomo ilawulwa ngumthetho waseSpain. Kusebenza imithetho yokuvikelwa kwabathengi be-EU, enikeza abathengi ilungelo lokufaka izimangalo ezinkantolo zendawo abahlala kuyo. Akukho ukulamula okuphoqelelwe kubathengi be-EU (Directive 93/13/EEC).
legal.terms.p_042: Abathengi be-EU bangasebenzisa inkundla yokuxazulula izingxabano ku-inthanethi ye-European Commission: ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.
